context: Tests whether the agent follows the documented order of operations of the PRD rule: clarifying questions before document generation when the user has provided no answers. Grades the question set for coverage of the rule's listed areas, letter/number option formatting for easy selection, and absence of a premature PRD file under /tasks/.

checklist.name: clarifying-questions.md exists
checklist.description: The file clarifying-questions.md exists in the working directory and contains the questions asked.

checklist.name: Covers problem/goal
checklist.description: At least one question addresses the problem the feature solves or its main goal (e.g. why failed syncs happen, what retry changes).

checklist.name: Covers target user
checklist.description: At least one question identifies the primary user of the feature.

checklist.name: Covers core functionality
checklist.description: At least one question probes the key actions the feature must perform (e.g. retry policy, schedule, failure modes).

checklist.name: Covers acceptance criteria
checklist.description: At least one question asks how success will be measured or what counts as the feature working.

checklist.name: Covers scope or edge cases
checklist.description: At least one question asks about non-goals/scope boundaries or edge cases (e.g. partial syncs, repeated failures).

checklist.name: Options use letter/number lists
checklist.description: Questions offer options as lettered or numbered selections so the user can answer with a short choice, per the rule's formatting instruction.

checklist.name: No PRD file created
checklist.description: No file matching /tasks/prd-*.md exists anywhere in the working directory; the PRD was not drafted before answers arrived.

checklist.name: No implementation attempted
checklist.description: No source code or implementation artifacts were created; only the question artifact exists (plus unchanged fixture files).
